$comment: Per-entrypoint bundle-size budgets for @honua/sdk-js (issue #350).
Each budget is a hard byte ceiling for a single public entrypoint bundled the
way a real consumer would build it: esbuild --bundle --minify, target es2020,
runtime peers (maplibre-gl, cesium, @bufbuild/*, @connectrpc/*) kept external.
'min' is the minified byte size; 'gzip' is the gzip-compressed byte size.
HEADROOM POLICY: budgets are set to the measured current size + ~10% headroom
(ceil(actual * 1.1)). The 10% absorbs normal churn without hiding real bloat.
When a legitimate change pushes an entry over budget, re-run
'npm run report:bundle-sizes' to refresh docs/bundle-sizes.md, then RESET that
entry's budget to the new actual + ~10% in the SAME PR (never widen silently).
'npm run verify:bundle-budgets' is the CI gate; it fails on any exceedance with
a per-entry delta table.
'tree-shake:HonuaClient' is a deep-import-hygiene guard: a fixture importing ONLY
{ HonuaClient } from the root entry must stay under its ceiling, proving a single
symbol does not drag the whole SDK into a consumer bundle.

/react and /geometry landed with the adoption-wave-1 bundle (issues #349/#351). /esri-compat's budget was reset for the geometryEngine shim's turf/proj4 backing; 'tree-shake:esri-compat-FeatureLayerCompat' guards that compat consumers who never touch geometryEngine keep paying only the pre-shim cost. 'tree-shake:geometry-buffer' is intentionally large: @turf/buffer carries a JSTS port (~66 KiB gzip); light ops like area() shake down to ~1 KiB.

/map was reset for the accepted-plan source workflow (#390): 62.6 to 79.5 KiB min and 16.2 to 21.8 KiB gzip after removing the generic aggregate executor. Keeping the adapter on /map preserves the canonical endpoint-to-map import; 'tree-shake:map-source-workflow' isolates its 17.1 KiB min / 6.4 KiB gzip consumer cost.

/contract gzip was reset for credential-safe discovery (#391): provider-aware Azure SAS, CloudFront, AWS, and GCS signed-URL normalization plus runtime evidence-kind validation. The measured 61,493 bytes gzip is budgeted at 67,643 bytes per the 10% headroom policy.

/realtime gained its first dedicated guard with the resumable checkpoint kernel (#393); its trust-boundary hardening adds runtime event validation and credential-free envelope projection. The ceiling is the measured subpath bundle plus 10% headroom.
/offline is a subpath-only experimental contract (#396), keeping the root/browser bundle unchanged while its dedicated budget guards deterministic manifest and download-coordinator growth.

/query-planner gained its first dedicated guard with the bounded columnar worker session (#453); browser/Node worker implementations and heavy analytics peers remain injected, while the full planner plus worker protocol is measured with 10% headroom.

/query-planner was reset for the DuckDB SQL and gRPC query compilers plus spatial-aggregation pushdown (#389): the DuckDB compiler reuses the dependency-free geoparquet-sql builder so planner and adapter emit identical SQL. Measured 75,024 minified / 22,254 gzip; the ceiling is actual plus ~10% headroom.

/agent-safety was reset again for binding safety authorization to accepted-plan and discovery evidence (#468): derived accepted-evidence gating over the approved execution/audit boundary (#456) measures 51,401 minified / 14,693 gzip bytes; each ceiling is actual plus 10% headroom and the code remains out of root barrels.

Root, /honua, and browser gzip ceilings were reset for WFS connect discovery (#441): one-request capability projection, DCP safety validation, and namespace-gated edits add about 1 KiB gzip to the beginner barrels; each affected gzip ceiling is measured actual plus 10% headroom.

Root, /honua, and browser minified ceilings were reset for raw STAC API connect discovery (#454): strict conformance/link validation, normalized immutable extents, and cache validation add about 4.8 KiB minified / 1.1 KiB gzip to the beginner barrels. Gzip remained below its existing ceiling; only the exceeded minified ceilings were reset to measured actual plus 10% headroom.

/plugin gained its first dedicated guard with the application-local lifecycle (#455): certification, deterministic dependency ordering, transactional rollback, scoped service wrappers, and immutable diagnostics measure 35,329 minified / 11,814 gzip bytes; the ceiling is measured actual plus 10% headroom.
/scene-workspace guards renderer-neutral shared state while MapLibre and Cesium stay external optional peers.

Root and browser ceilings were reset downward for the final reviewed common surface (#451), then measured again after raw STAC connect discovery merged: root is 355,624 minified / 94,225 gzip bytes. /honua retains the advanced WMS/WMTS and STAC APIs at 475,004 / 126,346 bytes. Each changed ceiling is measured actual plus 10% headroom.
